verdict.rationale: Probes show no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec (all 404). However, Pomelo documents an official MCP, installable in Cursor, whose tools search its API docs for matching endpoints and generate request code samples. That is a first-party, agent-oriented way into the docs, though not the static docs an agent can simply be pointed at. Missing for 10: llms.txt, markdown or plain-text doc exports, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration that the docs MCP works well.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Devuelve los endpoints que coincidan con una consulta específica en español o inglés.
Genera un ejemplo de código para realizar el request al endpoint.
Para instalar nuestro MCP en Cursor, puedes hacer clic en el botón a continuación o seguir los pasos manualmente.
